interpretation: The task1-only 40k run reproduces the fixed-init3 failure phenotype of mixed-batch8 despite identical recorded starts, while the 160k homogeneous joint4 condition succeeds on those starts. This is consistent with a training-horizon/schedule or treatment difference but does not identify cause. The paired comparisons are one-seed descriptive contrasts, neither McNemar comparison is significant at 0.05, and matching the listed first-input fields does not validate the separately invalidated historical V3 parity claim.
limits: The task1-only condition matches the task0 single-task 40k schedule/sample budget, not the homogeneous joint4 160k optimizer schedule.
